extracted_information: The web content provides a detailed comparison of the top 12 free AI chat widgets for customer support and engagement in 2025. It defines what an AI chat widget is, highlights its importance and benefits, and then offers a comprehensive analysis of individual platforms including their primary use cases, pricing models, key features (pros), and limitations (cons).

specifications.ai_chat_widget_definition: A powerful tool allowing businesses to integrate real-time chat capabilities into their websites, leveraging AI for instant responses, automating customer support, qualifying leads, and guiding users 24/7. They are typically easy to set up, customizable, and often include analytics features.
benefits_of_ai_chat_widgets_for_customer: Improved Customer Engagement: Fosters real-time communication, increasing satisfaction and loyalty.
24/7 Availability: Provides continuous support, addressing inquiries promptly even outside business hours.
Automated Support: AI handles common inquiries, saving staff time and reducing customer wait times.
Improved Conversion Rates: Addresses customer concerns instantly, increasing likelihood of purchase or sign-up.
Valuable Insights and Feedback: Analytics track user interactions, informing product development and marketing strategies.

pricing: The article reviews platforms ranging from completely free options (Tawk.to, Chatango) to those with free plans having limited features (Landbot, Smartsupp, Chatling, IntelliTicks, HubSpot) and paid plans starting from various price points (e.g., ProProfs Live Chat at $19.99/operator/month, Botsify at $49/month, Kommunicate at $83.33/month, Zendesk at $55/month, ChatBot at $52/month). Free trials are also mentioned for several paid platforms.
features: The platforms offer a wide array of features including AI-powered chatbots, live chat functionality, real-time monitoring, customizable widgets, multi-language support, integrations with third-party tools/CRMs, analytics, lead generation, human agent takeover, knowledge base support, pre-chat forms, post-chat surveys, and various communication channels (web, mobile, social media).

statistics.consumer_preference_live_chat: 41% of consumers prefer a live chat widget on websites for real-time assistance, reduced wait times, and personalized interactions.
